lines.text: Then why does mine feel like a steal?
That's anchoring. The first number you see sets the scale.
In 1974, Tversky and Kahneman spun a wheel that landed on 10 or 65, then asked what percent of UN countries are African.
lines.say: In nineteen seventy-four, Tversky and Kahneman spun a wheel that landed on ten or sixty-five, then asked what percent of U.N. countries are African.

card.title: TVERSKY & KAHNEMAN · 1974
card.body: A rigged wheel lands on 10 or 65. Then: guess a percentage.

lines.text: The sixty-five group guessed about 45. The ten group, about 25. From a random wheel.
lines.say: The sixty-five group guessed about forty-five. The ten group, about twenty-five. From a random wheel.

lines.text: That "was nine hundred" is your wheel. Ask what it's worth to you.
Be honest: do you check the real price, or just the discount?
